mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, John Ehlers' 2025 Laguerre Oscillator crossing zero on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a low-lag trend direction transition; follow the new sign for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a strict nonpositive-to-positive Laguerre Oscillator crossing; short on a strict nonnegative-to-negative crossing
mechanism.why_distinct: The oscillator first applies a 30-period UltimateSmoother, forms a gamma-0.5 Laguerre delayed state from current and prior smoother values, and RMS-normalizes their difference over 100 decisions. It is not Laguerre RSI, a range-envelope reentry, moving-average crossover, raw return sum, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the published low-lag trend transition must coincide with completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse RMS-normalized Laguerre-state sign transitions are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.ultimate_smoother: published second-order 30-period recursive UltimateSmoother of completed close
features.laguerre_oscillator: current smoother minus Laguerre state, divided by 100-decision RMS of that difference
features.event: strict finite oscillator zero crossing from the immediately prior finite oscillator
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: all recursive and RMS state resets after any invalid completed four-hour bar; output requires 100 uninterrupted differences

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published Ehlers Laguerre Oscillator(0.5,30,100) zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no gamma, period, recursion, initialization, RMS, threshold, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers, Laguerre Filters, TASC July 2025
external_basis.fixed_definition: gamma=0.5, UltimateSmoother length=30, RMS length=100; L1=-gamma*L0+prior L0+gamma*prior L1; oscillator=(L0-L1)/RMS; zero-line sign denotes trend direction
external_basis.selection_use: published defaults, formula, normalization, and zero-line direction only; no incidence or outcomes
